name: Adam Schiff
subject: The gravity of the situation
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Chris Pappas for Senate
body:
We can’t afford to disengage or turn away.
[](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260108_1.jZWwsb&refcode=em20260108-1&t=1&akid=4455%2E582294%2Ej3h_Dv)
Hi team, this is Adam Schiff.
Lately, I’ve been thinking a lot about the gravity of the situation we’re facing.
**[I want to share some thoughts with you — but before I do, will you pitch in any amount to my campaign and Chris Pappas?](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260108_1.jZWwsb&refcode=em20260108-1&t=2&akid=4455%2E582294%2Ej3h_Dv)**
**[Pitch In »](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260108_1.jZWwsb&refcode=em20260108-1&t=3&akid=4455%2E582294%2Ej3h_Dv)**
We are living in unprecedented times. Never before has our country faced such deep threats to our democracy.
Health insurance costs are ballooning because they took money out of health care for a tax cut for rich people. People are worried about making ends meet. Housing costs are skyrocketing.
Meanwhile, Trump and his allies in Congress are more interested in going after their rivals than fixing these economic crises.
**It's a lot, and I understand why you might want a break.**
But we can’t afford to disengage or turn away. There are too many important fights that we must continue to wage — for an economy that works for everyone, for our democracy, and for the health and safety of us all.
**The future is not set; it is up to us, and we can make all the difference.**
And there are good reasons for hope. Millions of Americans have come out to protest against the president. Courts are ruling in our favor. And we scored important victories in November in California, New Jersey, and Virginia.
**[To prepare for the battles ahead, I'm humbly asking for your support today. So please, can I count on you to chip in any amount you can to Chris Pappas and me to support my fight to defend our democracy and deliver for working people? Your support makes a huge difference.](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260108_1.jZWwsb&refcode=em20260108-1&t=4&akid=4455%2E582294%2Ej3h_Dv)**
**[Donate $5 »](https://act.chrispappas.org/go/181?c0=em_ms_cp_20260108_1.jZWwsb&amount=5&refcode=em20260108-1&t=23&akid=4455%2E582294%2Ej3h_Dv)**
Thank you for being part of this grassroots team and having my back every step of the way.
— Adam
This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. Email is a critical way we communicate with grassroots supporters like you. However, if you would like to change your subscription preferences, here are some options:
* [Receive Fewer Emails](https://act.chrispappas.org/signup/cps_receive_fewer_emails/?t=24&akid=4455%2E582294%2Ej3h_Dv)

name: Jenny Beth Martin, Tea Party Patriots Action
subject: URGENT Call to Action: Safeguard Our Elections
body:
Join President Trump in telling the U.S. Senate to pass the SAVE Act!
[](https://emails.teapartypatriots.org/CL0/https:%2F%2Fwww.teapartypatriots.org/1/0100019b9f15206b-af797057-d422-4389-a46a-00dcdeb86a34-000000/wQcyFVVwjXoq6co5vAuw0unLih9R2JnuUlj5LmwMvTE=439)Patriot–We need you to advance election integrity, support President Trump and help to **safeguard American elections** by urging the U.S. Senate to pass the SAVE Act!Last year, many of you and tens of thousands of your fellow patriots signed our petition as part of the Only Citizens Vote Bus Tour—a bold grassroots effort to support the SAVE Act.President Trump has joined the call to pass the SAVE Act and [_needs your help_](https://emails.teapartypatriots.org/CL0/https:%2F%2Faction.teapartypatriots.org%2Fpetition%2Fonlycitizensvote%2F/1/0100019b9f15206b-af797057-d422-4389-a46a-00dcdeb86a34-000000/EyNM236XQDSlYjLuhWMYxn20ACdfa05XQ_s4xxYHMUc=439) to get this crucial election integrity legislation across the finish line. He even suggested changing the name to The SAVE America Act – which emphasizes the importance of this legislation![](https://emails.teapartypatriots.org/CL0/https:%2F%2Faction.teapartypatriots.org%2Fpetition%2Fonlycitizensvote%2F/2/0100019b9f15206b-af797057-d422-4389-a46a-00dcdeb86a34-000000/4MT-goWl5qr00VDd7p9nz0z22Ywc7tNNqdbnNeeNNpM=439)The right to vote in the United States is sacred to all of us, and **allowing non-citizens to participate dilutes the voices of American citizens**.The Safeguarding American Voter Eligibility (SAVE) Act, which has already passed the U.S. House of Representatives, mandates proof of citizenship at the time of voter registration—closing loopholes that currently allow noncitizens to register and vote in our elections. Yet, shockingly, the U.S. Senate continues to stall. The SAVE Act is stuck in the U.S. Senate Committee on Rules and Administration, chaired by Senator Mitch McConnell.[_**Call your senators now and tell them that it’s past time the Senate Rules Committee passes the SAVE Act and allows it on the Senate floor for a vote.**_](https://emails.teapartypatriots.org/CL0/https:%2F%2Faction.teapartypatriots.org%2Fpetition%2Fonlycitizensvote%2F/3/0100019b9f15206b-af797057-d422-4389-a46a-00dcdeb86a34-000000/1h6Uzl89Kp4B-VDJyRjsOlzqHNF1DpRZDkGFpU1MDyc=439)[ ONLY CITIZENS VOTE](https://emails.teapartypatriots.org/CL0/https:%2F%2Faction.teapartypatriots.org%2Fpetition%2Fonlycitizensvote%2F/4/0100019b9f15206b-af797057-d422-4389-a46a-00dcdeb86a34-000000/_wIdt9vB-ck-gvHZiCpxsq0Wa2FRe4OEHvHrKuUKmbc=439)We will not sit back and watch as our votes continue to be diluted by non-citizens due to loopholes in the National Voter Registration Act and the Uniformed and Overseas Citizens Absentee Voting Act.Americans should have full faith and confidence that our elections are legitimate and decided only by lawful ballots cast by U.S. citizens.[_**Tell the Senate to pass the SAVE Act NOW!**_](https://emails.teapartypatriots.org/CL0/https:%2F%2Faction.teapartypatriots.org%2Fpetition%2Fonlycitizensvote%2F/5/0100019b9f15206b-af797057-d422-4389-a46a-00dcdeb86a34-000000/q2ToRwDJ9VpgIVAT3sMbn_hd2rm5ySkLp3dYMvO7rEQ=439) In liberty
Jenny Beth Martin[CONTRIBUTE](https://emails.teapartypatriots.org/CL0/https:%2F%2Fwww.teapartypatriots.org%2Fdonate%2F/1/0100019b9f15206b-af797057-d422-4389-a46a-00dcdeb86a34-000000/nBsJCOIoMxsn1pkNxiND_5kdynUTehwR7PjBL0AaQVs=439) _This email list is a joint venture of the following separate organizations: Tea Party Patriots Action, Inc., Tea Party Patriots Foundation, and Tea Party Patriots Citizens Fund. # [2025: A year in Review](https://substack.com/app-link/post?publication_id=6380051&post_id=183922823&utm_source=post-email-title&utm_campaign=email-post-title&isFreemail=true&r=1hvr60&token=eyJ1c2VyX2lkIjo5MDUwMTE5MiwicG9zdF9pZCI6MTgzOTIyODIzLCJpYXQiOjE3Njc5MDA3MTEsImV4cCI6MTc3MDQ5MjcxMSwiaXNzIjoicHViLTYzODAwNTEiLCJzdWIiOiJwb3N0LXJlYWN0aW9uIn0.w7DRid8_TKluUyUHk3yCS4_RI_mVbxPYHmfd9pZNocs)
### Fighting for Michiganders
| | [Haley Stevens](https://substack.com/@haleyformi)
---
| Jan 8
---
| [](https://substack.com/@haleyformi)
---

---
| | | [](https://substack..1l74AHR8rtYAi2F9rMS19qijZel96bpnxwp3_Ph0fMk?&utm_source=substack&utm_medium=email)
---
| | [READ IN APP](https://open.substack.com/pub/haleyformi/p/2025-a-year-in-review?utm_source=email&redirect=app-store&utm_campaign=email-read-in-app)
---

Hi friends,
As we closed the book on 2025, I've been reflecting on what this year meant for Michigan - and what it demanded from all of us.
**It was not an easy year.** Families in our state and across the country felt the impact of higher grocery bills, rising health care costs, and attacks on the research and science that keep our communities safe and healthy.
I've heard those concerns in town halls, on shop floors, in classrooms, and in kitchens across Michigan. _And I carry them with me every single day._
But here's what else I've seen: Michigan grit, resilience, and determination. I've seen it in the small-business owners navigating supply chain chaos, the engineers and autoworkers building our future, and the working families who keep showing up, even as costs soar and it feels like the entire system is rigged against them.
**I 'm proud of what we accomplished together in 2025. **From legislation to constituent service to simply showing up and listening, our work this year was grounded in one thing: fighting for Michiganders.
This year, I introduced and supported legislation to lower costs, bring jobs back home, and stand up to abuses of power:
* **No Tariffs on Groceries Act** - to stop the president from imposing food tariffs that raise prices at the checkout counter
* **Union Auto Workers Job Protection Act** - to protect good-paying union jobs and defend Michigan's auto industry
* **UNEARTH America 's Future Act** - to strengthen our critical mineral supply chains and reduce dependence on China
* **Stop Trump 's Abuse of Power Act** - to ensure no president can deploy the military for personal political gain
* **Articles of Impeachment against RFK Jr.** - to ensure public officials who endanger our health are held accountable

**By the Numbers**
We showed up, we listened, and we delivered. This year, our team:
* Toured Southeast Michigan during our **Manufacturing Monday** visits
* Resolved **hundreds of constituent cases**
* Returned over **$13 million** in federal benefits to MI-11 families

And since 2019, we've returned over **$139 million** to families in our district.
From visiting plants to standing with hunger relief organizations, from launching Manufacturing Day to helping families navigate Social Security and health insurance, every part of my job comes back to one thing: serving the people who make Michigan strong.
As we look ahead to 2026, I know the challenges are still huge. But so is our capacity for progress. I'm ready to keep fighting.
Thank you for believing in this work. Thank you for being part of this movement.
With grit and gratitude,

Haley
* * *

A personal note from Haley 👋

I'm a lifelong Michigander and the daughter of small-business owners. I've spent my career fighting for Michigan's working families - and now I'm running for the U.S. Senate to keep standing up for the people I love.

But here's the truth: Senate control could come down to Michigan. And Trump and his megadonors know it. That's why they're gearing up to spend tens of millions to defeat me and hand this seat to a MAGA Republican.

I need your help to fight back. This race will be one of the most competitive - and expensive - in the country, and I'm counting on grassroots support to win.

If you're with me, will you chip in today?

name: Gov. Andy Beshear
subject: The state of Kentucky is strong and worth fighting for.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by In This Together PAC
body:
I spoke directly and clearly, and I meant every word.
Peter,

Last night, I spoke directly to the people of Kentucky in my State of the Commonwealth address.

And I meant every word when I said this: **The state of Kentucky remains strong.**

Together, we've built one of the strongest economies in our history. We've had massive job growth, _including our second-best year ever for job creation._ We've shown the country what's possible when people come together across party lines, across geography, and focus on results instead of division.

_But I also spoke honestly about what's at stake right now, and where we go from here._ For too many families, the American Dream feels like it's slipping away. The simple promise that if you work hard and play by the rules, you can get ahead, afford a home, take a family vacation, and leave your kids better off than you were. That dream should be real in every corner of Kentucky — from our biggest cities to our most rural communities.

That's what I've fought for as governor, but right now, that dream is under threat from a reckless administration that is working against us, not with us. Bad tariff and trade policies are slowing projects and obliterating jobs, and President Trump's "big, ugly bill" threatens rural hospitals, healthcare workers, and healthcare coverage for hundreds of thousands of people.

But while Washington creates chaos, here in Kentucky, we've chosen to invest in jobs, housing, healthcare, and in our people. Peter, my goal has always been simple: **To leave Kentucky better than I found it and ensure the leaders who come next continue that work.** I'm fighting back so families don't pay the price for reckless decisions made by politicians who couldn't care less what happens to them, but I can't do it alone.

_That's where you come in._

Peter,

As we kick off 2026 and charge toward the March 3 Republican primary, I'm grateful for your unwavering support. December was a productive month for our grassroots team—even amid the holiday season, we kept up steady, direct outreach to voters across Guadalupe, Bexar, Wilson, and Karnes counties. These person-to-person connections are the foundation of our campaign, allowing us to listen to your concerns and share our vision for stronger borders, family values, and economic opportunity.

**Here's what we accomplished in December:**

* * *
**Community Service with San Antonio Food Bank in Seguin**
Served alongside local leaders at the Seguin Food Pickup, putting people first and meeting real needs in Guadalupe County.

* * *
**District Ground Game in Action**
Throughout December, Josh traveled across TX-35 communities, meeting voters face-to-face and building local support heading into the new year.

* * *
**Holiday Support for First Responders**
Team Cortez dropped off Christmas cookies and milk to area firefighters, showing appreciation for our local first responders and spreading some holiday cheer to those serving our community.

* * *
**Spreading Holiday Cheer at the Christmas Parade**
In December, Josh joined the Floresville Christmas Parade, connecting with families and neighbors, celebrating the season, and keeping our campaign visible and engaged in the heart of the community.

* * *
**Honoring Our Fallen Heroes**
In December, Josh took part in a wreath-laying ceremony to honor the men and women who gave their lives for our country, paying respect to their sacrifice and the families they left behind.

* * *
**Closing 2025 on the Ground, Not Online**
While others slowed down for the holidays, Josh kept campaigning in person, finishing the year focused on turnout, organization, and winning this seat.

* * *
December was about showing up. While others took the month off, Josh stayed on the ground meeting voters, supporting first responders, honoring our fallen heroes, and engaging with families across the district. That work is setting the foundation for a strong 2026 campaign built on service, presence, and real connection with the people we’re fighting for.

Hello friends,

It's Gabby Giffords. On January 8, 2011 — 15 years ago today — my life forever changed when a gunman attempted to assassinate me while I was hosting a constituent event in Tucson, Arizona.

Six innocent people were killed that day: Christina-Taylor, Dorothy, Judge John Roll, Phyllis, Dorwan, and Gabe. I'll never forget their names. Twelve others were injured.

That shooting turned my life upside down. The bullet damaged the left side of my brain, where language is processed, leading to a condition called aphasia. While speaking is still difficult for me, I have never given up on my recovery journey, even on the most difficult days.

[](https://go.dscc.org/go/22390?amount=5&t=5&firstname=&lastname=&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&addr1=&addr2=&city=Cresco&state=Pennsylvania&zip=18326&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&ask=5&amounts=5%2C10%2C20%2C50&code=DPE-FM-20260108-GabbyGiffords-GiffordsTandem-Pros-sl1&refcode=DPE-FM-20260108-GabbyGiffords-GiffordsTandem-Pros-sl1&akid=22317%2E9716520%2EmZ2YMb)
The anniversary of this shooting is a painful one, but it also serves as a reminder of the way that we can come together in the wake of tragedy. I relearned how to walk and talk, and became a stronger Gabby — a healing journey that I continue on to this day.

Two years after I was shot, another life-altering shooting occurred — this time at Sandy Hook Elementary in Newtown, where 20 children and six adults were murdered.

I knew in that moment I had to do something, so Mark Kelly and I founded GIFFORDS with the mission to end gun violence and create a safer future for our nation's communities.

[](https://go.dscc.org/go/22390?amount=5&t=6&firstname=&lastname=&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&addr1=&addr2=&city=Cresco&state=Pennsylvania&zip=18326&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&ask=5&amounts=5%2C10%2C20%2C50&code=DPE-FM-20260108-GabbyGiffords-GiffordsTandem-Pros-sl1&refcode=DPE-FM-20260108-GabbyGiffords-GiffordsTandem-Pros-sl1&akid=22317%2E9716520%2EmZ2YMb)
When we founded GIFFORDS, many people warned us that it would be political poison to stand up against the gun lobby. They had millions of dollars at their disposal, and would use every cent to drown us out.

But the progress we've made is undeniable. We've beaten back the NRA and made gun safety a winning issue, thanks to supporters like you.

Now, we face an inflection point. President Trump's administration is working to roll back our progress on gun safety — putting all of their weight towards flooding our streets with more guns and helping their gun manufacturing buddies profit.

I know we have what it takes to end the gun violence epidemic in our country. But I cannot do it alone.

[**So I am humbly asking: Can you please split a donation between GIFFORDS PAC and the DSCC before the clock strikes midnight to support candidates who will fight for safer gun laws and take back the Senate majority?**](https://go.dscc.org/go/22390?amount=5&t=7&firstname=&lastname=&email=dpwillis67%40gmail.com&addr1=&addr2=&city=Cresco&state=Pennsylvania&zip=18326&phone=None&employer=&occupation=&ask=5&amounts=5%2C10%2C20%2C50&code=DPE-FM-20260108-GabbyGiffords-GiffordsTandem-Pros-sl1&refcode=DPE-FM-20260108-GabbyGiffords-GiffordsTandem-Pros-sl1&akid=22317%2E9716520%2EmZ2YMb)

That day in Tucson captured national attention — a sitting Congresswoman shot in the head. But the truth is that today, being shot isn't rare. Gun violence is a national crisis and now the leading cause of death for American kids and teens.

Make no mistake: the fight isn't over yet, and the headwinds we face are stiff. But if we all keep working together, I know that someday, there will be a future where we no longer live under the constant threat of gun violence.

With courage,

Gabby Giffords

Fellow Patriot,

Happy New Year.

The Republican House majority is hanging by a thread. It’s one of the slimmest margins in modern history, and if we lose even a handful of seats, Democrats take the gavel back.

**If that happens, everything stops.**

No border security. No accountability. Just investigations, obstruction, and nonstop attacks on President Trump and the America First agenda. We’ve seen this movie before—and it ends badly.

I’m Mark Lamb, former Sheriff of Pinal County, Arizona. I spent years dealing with the consequences of Washington’s failures firsthand. Open borders aren’t theoretical to me. They mean drug trafficking, human trafficking, and communities paying the price while politicians in D.C. do nothing.

_That’s why I’m running for Congress._

This race matters nationally. Border security affects every state. The House majority affects every issue. **And the truth is, Democrats absolutely could flip the House if Republicans don’t get serious right now.**

**President Donald Trump endorsed this campaign because he knows I won’t fold, cave, or play games. I’ll fight for secure borders, law and order, and putting American citizens first.**

**But with margins this tight, winning takes more than endorsements. It takes a strong grassroots effort—and that starts now.**

If they rule in favor of racial gerrymandering, they’ll rip voting rights away from and undermine the power of millions of Black and Brown voters across the country. **But neither of these decisions are foregone conclusions. United for Democracy has been leading the charge against corruption at the Supreme Court. Our experts, activists, and allies have put massive pressure on the MAGA justices to rule for the people, not the wannabe dictator.** [**No matter what decision is announced tomorrow, United for Democracy is ready. If they rule in favor of racial gerrymandering, they’ll rip voting rights away from and undermine the power of millions of Black and Brown voters across the country. But neither of these decisions are foregone conclusions. United for Democracy has been leading the charge against corruption at the Supreme Court. Our experts, activists, and allies have put massive pressure on the MAGA justices to rule for the people, not the wannabe dictator. Just like last year, this term at the Supreme Court will have an impact on millions of Americans. The cases they’re deciding on will determine who has the right to vote, who gets to be a citizen, and how much power Donald Trump has over our lives. Louisiana v. Callais —one of the cases that could be decided tomorrow—gives the MAGA justices the opportunity to rip up the Voting Rights Act once and for all. That’s something Chief Justice Roberts has been advocating for for decades. Trump’s tariffs case isn’t just about when it’s okay for the president to set tariffs. It’s about whether the Court will hand Trump broad, sweeping powers to remake our economy on a whim. United for Democracy is watching every minute, and mobilizing the rapid response. We the People need to know how the Court’s decisions are eroding our democracy, emboldening Trump, and hurting everyday Americans. Thank you for being a part of this fight, Stasha Rhodes United for Democracy P.S. Don’t have a Bluesky account? Paid for by United for Democracy. | | Sent via . [ stdin# ]Our Revolution Logo

Peter Willis,

Yesterday morning in Minneapolis, an ICE agent fired through the window
multiple times and murdered Renee Nicole Good. Renee was a loving mother,
a poet, and a U.S. citizen. She was just 37 and leaves behind three
children and a partner who will never again hear her voice, feel her hug,
or read her words.

Homeland Security Secretary Kristi Noem raced to justify this killing and
spread lies on national TV. But cell phone videos and eyewitnesses paint a
starkly different reality.

We CANNOT let this stand. A member of Congress is filing articles of
impeachment against Secretary Noem TODAY for her lies, abuses, and violent
escalation – and we need EVERYONE to join in to overwhelm Congress with
pressure to act.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/34933?source=email-20260108&t=1011&akid=10057%2E5885482%2Easn0Pf ]Headline: Illinois Rep. Robin Kelly filing articles of impeachment for
DHS Secretary Kristi Noem

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/34933?source=email-20260108&t=1012&akid=10057%2E5885482%2Easn0Pf ]Add your name now to demand Congress impeach Noam.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/34933?source=email-20260108&t=1013&akid=10057%2E5885482%2Easn0Pf ]ADD YOUR NAME

This was not a one-off tragedy. In recent days, the Trump administration
warned that it was launching its "largest operation to date" in the twin
cities. Noem led the way to deploying 2,000 federal agents who started
grabbing people off the streets and outside homes and schools, violently
tackling members of the community. Neighbors woke to SWAT teams and
helicopters. Children headed to school in fear.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/34933?source=email-20260108&t=1014&akid=10057%2E5885482%2Easn0Pf ]Headline: 2,000 federal agents sent to Minneapolis area to carry out
'largest immigration operation ever,' ICE says

One thing is clear: if we don't act to stop this, the violence will only
increase.

Last night, thousands poured into the streets across the country in
protest. But as unrest spreads, Noem and the rest of the Trump
administration are doubling down on lies and disinformation.

Congress needs to see massive public outrage to act and remove Noem from
power, NOW.

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/34933?source=email-20260108&t=1015&akid=10057%2E5885482%2Easn0Pf ]Will you urgently add your name to demand Congress impeach Noem?

[ https://act.ourrevolution.com/go/34933?source=email-20260108&t=1016&akid=10057%2E5885482%2Easn0Pf ]ADD YOUR NAME

We don't have time to wait as ICE continues terrorizing our communities.
Our Revolution and our allies just successfully pushed Avelo Airlines to
stop running its deportation flights and end its relationship with ICE.
Now, together, let's force Congress to confront this injustice and stop
the deadly violence. Together, let's show them the power of people
fighting back – for justice, for truth, and for Renee Nicole Good.

When we organize, we win,

Our Revolution

Today, I’m launching my reelection campaign to keep moving Pennsylvania forward – and keep getting stuff done. | Fight for Reform is dedicated to electing Democrats, transforming our broken campaign finance system, and ending _Citizens United_ state by state. If you would like to get fewer emails, [**_click here._**](https://act.fightforreform.org/go/59469?t=1&akid=23801%2E4449941%2EidAsH9) If you would like to unsubscribe, [**_click here._**](https://act.fightforreform.org/go/59470?t=2&akid=23801%2E4449941%2EidAsH9) [](https://act.fightforreform.org/go/71797?t=3&akid=23801%2E4449941%2EidAsH9) [Folks, I wanted you to hear it directly from me. **Today, I’m officially launching my reelection campaign for Governor of Pennsylvania.**](https://act.fightforreform.org/go/71797?t=4&akid=23801%2E4449941%2EidAsH9)

Hear me on this: we've gotten a whole lot done, on issues that have been stuck for decades. But there's always more to do. More people to help. More Pennsylvanians to protect. More bridges to build.

That’s why I’m running for reelection — to build upon the foundation we’ve laid, put more points on the board for Pennsylvania families, and keep getting sh*t done.

[**Folks, I hope you’ll split a donation between Fight For Reform and me to become a Day One Founding Donor to our campaign. Our team just set an ambitious $500,000 Day One Launch Goal, so we’re going to need a lot of help to reach that milestone and build all the momentum we’ll need to win this race and keep Pennsylvania moving forward.**](https://act.fightforreform.org/go/71797?t=5&akid=23801%2E4449941%2EidAsH9) | [DONATE →](https://act.fightforreform.org/go/71797?t=6&akid=23801%2E4449941%2EidAsH9)
---
Growing up in Montgomery County, my parents raised me with a core set of values: Work hard. Give back. Stand up for others. And folks, they led by example. As a pediatrician, my dad helped lead kids and families through the stress of challenging, uncertain moments. And as an educator, my mom taught me and so many other kids to care about the world around us.

Watching their work up close inspired me to follow in their footsteps — but in a different way. Instead of medicine or education, I wanted to help Pennsylvanians through public service. By cleaning up our government, solving problems, and making life better for the families I served.

That’s what I did as a State Representative, when I helped pass some of the toughest ethics laws in Pennsylvania history. It’s what I did as Attorney General, when I got justice for survivors of sexual abuse, protected health care access, and won in court dozens of times to defend our democracy. [**And folks, it’s what I’m doing right now as Pennsylvania’s 48th Governor.**](https://act.fightforreform.org/go/71797?t=7&akid=23801%2E4449941%2EidAsH9)

Together, we’ve cut taxes seven times, putting millions back into the pockets of parents, seniors, and small businesses. We’ve invested a record amount of money in public education and served over 90 million free breakfasts to Pennsylvania students. We’ve created over 18,000 jobs, grown our economy, and expanded opportunity across our Commonwealth. And yes, we’ve protected abortion rights, ensuring every Pennsylvanian has the freedom to access the health care they need.

[**But my work isn’t finished.**](https://act.fightforreform.org/go/71797?t=8&akid=23801%2E4449941%2EidAsH9) Today, Pennsylvanians are facing unprecedented challenges with a White House hell bent on raising costs, attacking our freedoms, and undermining our democracy.

And this year, we have the chance to defeat the politics of chaos, division, and extremism that are making it harder across our Commonwealth. We have the opportunity to show the nation that hatred and division are not the way forward. That means standing up to the politicians who enable Donald Trump and JD Vance – even when they know their policies hurt Pennsylvanians.

[**Folks, let’s keep moving our Commonwealth forward together. It’s going to take a full team effort here, and the success of our campaign will come down to grassroots supporters like you. So I’m humbly asking: Can you join our team by rushing a split donation between Fight For Reform and my campaign and become a Day One Founding Donor?**](https://act.fightforreform.org/go/71797?t=9&akid=23801%2E4449941%2EidAsH9)

subject: I’m calling for the impeachment of this administration’s most lawless and abusive official. Will you join me?
disclaimer_text: Paid for by McBride for Delaware
body:
Yesterday in Minnesota, an ICE agent shot and killed a woman as she tried to drive away.
#
Yesterday in Minnesota, an ICE agent shot and killed a woman named Renee Nicole Good as she tried to drive away.
**There is no excuse for murder.**
This administration has repeatedly sent ICE into communities with little regard for safety, tearing families apart while expanding the agency’s budget, power, and authority.
_The Department of Homeland Security’s very own handbook forbids the behavior of the agent who killed Renee._ But the truth is that these agents are not properly trained — the Trump administration has given them a blank check. This is out of control.

| | Dear Peter,
---
At Save the Redwoods League, we’re striding confidently into 2026. Yes, there are headwinds. But we're leaning into them and choosing hope and resilience. Our optimism isn’t abstract. We’re buoyed by the conservation wins to come and the promise of restorative, magical moments in the redwoods. To help you join in, we’ve compiled **[26 can’t-miss experiences and feel-good moments for 2026](https://click.everyaction.com/k/122931542/593913686/537393887?utm_medium=email&utm_source=ea-mar&utm_campaign=01082026_editorial&sourceid=1168345&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9TVFJXTC9TVFJXTC8xLzg5NTc0IiwNCiAgIkRpc3RyaWJ1dGlvblVuaXF1ZUlkIjogIjE3NTM0YWRmLWQ0ZWMtZjAxMS04MTk1LTAwMGQzYTFkNThhYSIsDQogICJFbWFpbEFkZHJlc3MiOiAiZHB3aWxsaXM2N0BnbWFpbC5jb20iDQp9&hmac=N-_hQu4tNiSCbcvUOujLDXxl-3ka3py6oN1H_rfmYuk=&emci=02dde08c-0cec-f011-8195-000d3a1d58aa&emdi=17534adf-d4ec-f011-8195-000d3a1d58aa&ceid=1504551).** Our list includes opportunities for adventure, from lunar eclipses to whale spotting to guided hikes among giant trees. It features historic milestones like transferring ‘O Rew to the Yurok Tribe and local celebrations like the annual Salmon Festival. Plus cabin coziness, mushroom foraging, and winter backpacking beneath sequoias.Please explore the full list, discover your next source of inspiration, and join us in making 2026 a year of strength and hope.

clean_body: This year, joy is our compass. And our backbone.| | | | | | | | | Dear Peter, At Save the Redwoods League, we’re striding confidently into 2026. Yes, there are headwinds. But we're leaning into them and choosing hope and resilience. Our optimism isn’t abstract. We’re buoyed by the conservation wins to come and the promise of restorative, magical moments in the redwoods. To help you join in, we’ve compiled . Our list includes opportunities for adventure, from lunar eclipses to whale spotting to guided hikes among giant trees. It features historic milestones like transferring ‘O Rew to the Yurok Tribe and local celebrations like the annual Salmon Festival. Plus cabin coziness, mushroom foraging, and winter backpacking beneath sequoias.Please explore the full list, discover your next source of inspiration, and join us in making 2026 a year of strength and hope. | | In joy and resilience, Save the Redwoods League Photo by Karl Gohl | | Save the Redwoods League 111 Sutter Street, 11th Floor San Francisco, CA 94104 United States CONNECT WITH US | | | | | | ---|---|---|---|---|--- |

(Photo Credit: Marki Pyke/Daily Herald)
By Illinois Review

A new poll released by WGN-TV offers the first major snapshot of the 2026 Illinois Republican primary for governor – and it shows former state Sen. Darren Bailey with a clear early lead.

The survey, commissioned by WGN-TV and conducted by Emerson College Polling, was fielded January 3-5, 2026, among likely Republican primary voters.

Bailey leads the field with 34.4 percent. Businessman Ted Dabrowski trails far behind at 8.2 percent, followed by DuPage County Sheriff James Mendrick at 5.4 percent. Rick Heidner registers at just 1.1 percent.
https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2026/01/first-major-gop-poll-shows-bailey-surging-ahead-of-dabrowski-34-8.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=dd4fc37607-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_10_30_09_24_COPY_01&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-8b40ac336f-666344823
While 46.4 percent of voters remain undecided, Bailey’s advantage is notable this early in the race. The Republican primary is March 17.

Bailey’s lead comes as he has aggressively rolled out policy proposals centered on crime, affordability, and accountability – issues that continue to plague Illinois families under one-party Democratic control.

He has made clear that public safety will be a priority in a Bailey administration, pledging to ensure violent and repeat offenders do not remain on the streets endangering communities. Bailey has repeatedly criticized Democratic leadership for siding with criminals over victims, pointing to Chicago’s persistent violence as proof of failure.

On Thursday, Bailey expanded on that message during a press conference outlining his “Blueprint for Illinois.” The plan would cap annual property tax increases so families are not paying more in property taxes than their mortgage, freeze energy rate hikes, and require public audits of major utility contracts to restore transparency and trust.

body:
#

[](https://act.gallegoforarizona.com/go/1000?c0=ruben-giffords-em-jan26.0JwlYq&refcode=em260108-1-160&refcode2=4060.734936.m7NesS&t=1&akid=4060%2E734936%2Em7NesS)
---
Hello Peter,
It’s Gabby Giffords. On January 8, 2011 — 15 years ago today — my life forever changed when a gunman attempted to assassinate me while I was hosting a constituent event in Tucson, Arizona.
Six innocent people were killed that day: Christina-Taylor, Dorothy, Judge John Roll, Phyllis, Dorwan, and Gabe. I’ll never forget their names. Twelve others were injured.
That shooting turned my life upside down. The bullet damaged the left side of my brain, where language is processed, leading to a condition called aphasia. While speaking is still difficult for me, I have never given up on my recovery journey, even on the most difficult days.
[](https://act.gallegoforarizona.com/go/1000?c0=ruben-giffords-em-jan26.0JwlYq&refcode=em260108-1-160&t=2&akid=4060%2E734936%2Em7NesS)
The anniversary of this shooting is a painful one, but it also serves as a reminder of the way that we can come together in the wake of tragedy. I relearned how to walk and talk, and became a stronger Gabby — a healing journey that I continue on to this day.
Two years after I was shot, another life-altering shooting occurred — this time at Sandy Hook Elementary in Newtown, where 20 children and six adults were murdered.
I knew in that moment I had to do something, so Mark Kelly and I founded GIFFORDS with the mission to end gun violence and create a safer future for our nation’s communities.
[](https://act.gallegoforarizona.com/go/1000?c0=ruben-giffords-em-jan26.0JwlYq&refcode=em260108-1-160&t=3&akid=4060%2E734936%2Em7NesS)
When we founded GIFFORDS, many people warned us that it would be political poison to stand up against the gun lobby. They had millions of dollars at their disposal, and would use every cent to drown us out.
But the progress we’ve made is undeniable. We’ve beaten back the NRA and made gun safety a winning issue, thanks to supporters like you.
Now, we face an inflection point. President Trump’s administration is working to roll back our progress on gun safety — putting all of their weight towards flooding our streets with more guns and helping their gun manufacturing buddies profit.
I know we have what it takes to end the gun violence epidemic in our country. But I cannot do it alone.
[**So I am humbly asking: Can you please split a donation between GIFFORDS PAC and Ruben Gallego before the clock strikes midnight?**](https://act.gallegoforarizona.com/go/1000?c0=ruben-giffords-em-jan26.0JwlYq&refcode=em260108-1-160&t=4&akid=4060%2E734936%2Em7NesS)

****
That day in Tucson captured national attention — a sitting Congresswoman shot in the head. But the truth is that today, being shot isn’t rare. Gun violence is a national crisis and now the leading cause of death for American kids and teens.
Make no mistake: the fight isn’t over yet, and the headwinds we face are stiff. But if we all keep working together, I know that someday, there will be a future where we no longer live under the constant threat of gun violence.

clean_body: Hello Peter, It’s Gabby Giffords. On January 8, 2011 — 15 years ago today — my life forever changed when a gunman attempted to assassinate me while I was hosting a constituent event in Tucson, Arizona. Six innocent people were killed that day: Christina-Taylor, Dorothy, Judge John Roll, Phyllis, Dorwan, and Gabe. I’ll never forget their names. Twelve others were injured. That shooting turned my life upside down. The bullet damaged the left side of my brain, where language is processed, leading to a condition called aphasia. While speaking is still difficult for me, I have never given up on my recovery journey, even on the most difficult days. The anniversary of this shooting is a painful one, but it also serves as a reminder of the way that we can come together in the wake of tragedy. I relearned how to walk and talk, and became a stronger Gabby — a healing journey that I continue on to this day. Two years after I was shot, another life-altering shooting occurred — this time at Sandy Hook Elementary in Newtown, where 20 children and six adults were murdered. I knew in that moment I had to do something, so Mark Kelly and I founded GIFFORDS with the mission to end gun violence and create a safer future for our nation’s communities. When we founded GIFFORDS, many people warned us that it would be political poison to stand up against the gun lobby. They had millions of dollars at their disposal, and would use every cent to drown us out. But the progress we’ve made is undeniable. We’ve beaten back the NRA and made gun safety a winning issue, thanks to supporters like you. Now, we face an inflection point. President Trump’s administration is working to roll back our progress on gun safety — putting all of their weight towards flooding our streets with more guns and helping their gun manufacturing buddies profit. I know we have what it takes to end the gun violence epidemic in our country. But I cannot do it alone. If you 've stored your info with ActBlue, we'll process your contribution instantly. | | ** | | | | | | | ** That day in Tucson captured national attention — a sitting Congresswoman shot in the head. But the truth is that today, being shot isn’t rare. Gun violence is a national crisis and now the leading cause of death for American kids and teens. Make no mistake: the fight isn’t over yet, and the headwinds we face are stiff. But if we all keep working together, I know that someday, there will be a future where we no longer live under the constant threat of gun violence. Friend, it's Heidi.
Prop 50 dramatically changed the dynamics of this campaign.
Under the current rules, when an incumbent decides to run in a different district within California, they're automatically granted an endorsement, no vote required.
That means that the sitting Congressman that abruptly switched districts to run in ours, CA-03, would've gotten this institutional support.
But there's a petitioning process that stops this.

body:
#
Peter —
Now that we’re on the air with our first TV ad, I wanted to pull back the curtain and explain a bit of our strategy.
We’re taking a risk to go big this early with a seven-figure ad buy.
But without the benefit of past statewide and federal campaigns, we’ve got a much steeper challenge than our opponents to get our message in front of voters. Making this big of an investment this early is a necessary gamble if we’re going to reach the voters we need to win.
Polling shows that our message in this movement to take back power for working people is resonating with the people we’ve been able to reach. Our fight against corporate and billionaire mega-donors rigging the system energizes everyone and brings Texans together, no matter their background.
But it doesn’t matter if people don’t hear from us. So that’s why we decided to go on the air earlier. But it’s going to stretch our budget. We still have to raise the money to fund the full ad buy and keep our message in front of voters as early voting is set to begin soon.

Growing up in Montgomery County, my parents raised me with a core set of values: Work hard. Give back. Stand up for others. And Derek, they led by example. As a pediatrician, my dad helped lead kids and families through the stress of challenging, uncertain moments. And as an educator, my mom taught me and so many other kids to care about the world around us.
Watching their work up close inspired me to follow in their footsteps — but in a different way. Instead of medicine or education, I wanted to help Pennsylvanians through public service. By cleaning up our government, solving problems, and making life better for the families I served.
That’s what I did as a State Representative, when I helped pass some of the toughest ethics laws in Pennsylvania history. It’s what I did as Attorney General, when I got justice for survivors of sexual abuse, protected health care access, and won in court dozens of times to defend our democracy. **And Derek, it’s what I’m doing right now as Pennsylvania’s 48th Governor.**
Together, we’ve cut taxes seven times, putting millions back into the pockets of parents, seniors, and small businesses. We’ve invested a record amount of money in public education and served over 90 million free breakfasts to Pennsylvania students. We’ve created over 18,000 jobs, grown our economy, and expanded opportunity across our Commonwealth. And yes, we’ve protected abortion rights, ensuring every Pennsylvanian has the freedom to access the health care they need.
**But my work isn’t finished.** Today, Pennsylvanians are facing unprecedented challenges with a White House hell bent on raising costs, attacking our freedoms, and undermining our democracy.
And this year, we have the chance to defeat the politics of chaos, division, and extremism that are making it harder across our Commonwealth. We have the opportunity to show the nation that hatred and division are not the way forward. That means standing up to the politicians who enable Donald Trump and JD Vance — even when they know their policies hurt Pennsylvanians.
[Derek, let’s keep moving our Commonwealth forward together. It’s going to take a full team effort here, and the success of our campaign will come down to grassroots supporters like you. clean_body: Today, I’m launching my reelection campaign to keep moving Pennsylvania forward – and keep getting stuff done. | | | | Derek, I wanted you to hear it directly from me. Today, I’m officially launching my reelection campaign for Governor of Pennsylvania. Hear me on this: we've gotten a whole lot done, on issues that have been stuck for decades. But there's always more to do. More people to help. More Pennsylvanians to protect. More bridges to build. That’s why I’m running for reelection — to build upon the foundation we’ve laid, put more points on the board for Pennsylvania families, and keep getting sht done. | | Growing up in Montgomery County, my parents raised me with a core set of values: Work hard. Give back. Stand up for others. And Derek, they led by example. As a pediatrician, my dad helped lead kids and families through the stress of challenging, uncertain moments. And as an educator, my mom taught me and so many other kids to care about the world around us. Watching their work up close inspired me to follow in their footsteps — but in a different way. Instead of medicine or education, I wanted to help Pennsylvanians through public service. By cleaning up our government, solving problems, and making life better for the families I served. That’s what I did as a State Representative, when I helped pass some of the toughest ethics laws in Pennsylvania history. It’s what I did as Attorney General, when I got justice for survivors of sexual abuse, protected health care access, and won in court dozens of times to defend our democracy. And Derek, it’s what I’m doing right now as Pennsylvania’s 48th Governor. Together, we’ve cut taxes seven times, putting millions back into the pockets of parents, seniors, and small businesses. We’ve invested a record amount of money in public education and served over 90 million free breakfasts to Pennsylvania students. We’ve created over 18,000 jobs, grown our economy, and expanded opportunity across our Commonwealth. And yes, we’ve protected abortion rights, ensuring every Pennsylvanian has the freedom to access the health care they need. But my work isn’t finished. Today, Pennsylvanians are facing unprecedented challenges with a White House hell bent on raising costs, attacking our freedoms, and undermining our democracy. And this year, we have the chance to defeat the politics of chaos, division, and extremism that are making it harder across our Commonwealth. We have the opportunity to show the nation that hatred and division are not the way forward. That means standing up to the politicians who enable Donald Trump and JD Vance — even when they know their policies hurt Pennsylvanians. Let’s get to work. Peter,

Farmers are the heart of our communities.

They feed our families, support our local economies, and care for the land.

But the truth is, climate change is making their work harder than ever. Extreme weather, unpredictable seasons, and rising costs are threatening their livelihoods.

That's why Kim just introduced a bill to give farmers the tools they need to adapt, stay profitable, and protect our land for generations to come. The Partnerships for Agricultural Climate Action (PACA) Act would expand a proven Washington State program that helps farmers voluntarily reduce emissions, improve soil health, and prepare for extreme weather.

Peter, this bill isn't about mandates.

It's about giving farmers real options and support to make their farms more resilient. It also prioritizes first-time, and low-income farmers who often face the biggest challenges. Kim knows that supporting farmers is not just good policy—it's a responsibility of our leaders. Healthy, resilient farms mean stronger communities, safer food, and a more sustainable future for all of us. Will you stand with Kim and our farmers today?

clean_body: [PETITION] Peter, Farmers are the heart of our communities. They feed our families, support our local economies, and care for the land. But the truth is, climate change is making their work harder than ever. Extreme weather, unpredictable seasons, and rising costs are threatening their livelihoods. That's why Kim just introduced a bill to give farmers the tools they need to adapt, stay profitable, and protect our land for generations to come. The Partnerships for Agricultural Climate Action (PACA) Act would expand a proven Washington State program that helps farmers voluntarily reduce emissions, improve soil health, and prepare for extreme weather. Peter, this bill isn't about mandates. It's about giving farmers real options and support to make their farms more resilient. It also prioritizes first-time, and low-income farmers who often face the biggest challenges. Kim knows that supporting farmers is not just good policy—it's a responsibility of our leaders. Healthy, resilient farms mean stronger communities, safer food, and a more sustainable future for all of us. Will you stand with Kim and our farmers today? Thank you, DrKimSchrier.com Rep. ## Cliff & David Are Joined By Writer/Minnesota Resident, Walter Rhine
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/bee92d92-c4ee-4058-8fbb-7ebca46e5eb2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/bee92d92-c4ee-4058-8fbb-7ebca46e5eb2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
This episode of **Amped Up with Cliff Schecter** was raw, urgent, and politically clarifying. The outrageous, murderous actions by Donald Trump, [The Pentagon](https://substack.com/redirect/0e9adbbf-fd4e-4fa9-ab09-320c2deb2733?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), and the masked ghouls of ICE obviously created this atmosphere. The hosts and guest, while retaining their sense of humor, just weren't having it anymore.
As usual, Cliff was joined by co-host **David Shuster,** and Streamyard-ing in was guest **Walter Rhine.** All three [walked viewers through the human, moral, and political fallout of ICE violence in Minnesota and Defense Department violence in Caracas](https://substack.com/redirect/63298cac-5be2-41ec-8105-971fc1b79691?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)--and what Democrats _must do_ _right now_ in response.
### **1\. Minnesota in Crisis: Fear Is the Point**
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/bee92d92-c4ee-4058-8fbb-7ebca46e5eb2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Walter opened by describing why he kept his kids home from school--not abstract fear, potential violence unfolding in Minnesota after the horrific shooting. With ICE activity escalating near his community and masked agents operating without accountability, parents have been forced to make these decisions.
This isn't paranoia. It's the consequence of federal agents:
* refusing to identify themselves
* operating without visible oversight
* escalating confrontations amid protests

Walter framed it as **a decade-long escalation of racialized intimidation** , beginning the moment **Donald Trump** entered national politics.
### **2\. Shoot-First America: Minneapolis Not an Isolated Case**
Cliff drew a straight moral line between:
* the killing of **Renee Nicole Good** by ICE in Minneapolis
* [the bombing that killed ](https://substack.com/redirect/0e9adbbf-fd4e-4fa9-ab09-320c2deb2733?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**[Rosa Elena Gonzalez](https://substack.com/redirect/0e9adbbf-fd4e-4fa9-ab09-320c2deb2733?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)**[, an elderly woman in Venezuela](https://substack.com/redirect/0e9adbbf-fd4e-4fa9-ab09-320c2deb2733?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)

The connective tissue is **dehumanization** --a Trumpian political culture of Might Makes Right that treats certain lives as disposable, often even celebrates violence. Cliff argued the same logic fuels:
* [War Crimes in Venezuela](https://substack.com/redirect/395411e4-1754-40fe-a87b-fb7afc180d94?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
* [ICE brutality](https://substack.com/redirect/63298cac-5be2-41ec-8105-971fc1b79691?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)
* school shootings enabled by gun extremism

In Cliff's words: _If we can 't say the word "fuck" on TV, but we're fine with kids and grandmothers being slaughtered, our moral compass is broken._
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/bee92d92-c4ee-4058-8fbb-7ebca46e5eb2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
### **3\. White Supremacy as System, Not Exception**
Walter articulated a central thesis of the conversation:
> This isn't imported fascism. This is America's original sin, fully institutionalized, and encouraged to fly its freak flag proudly.
Key points:
* White supremacist ideology was **never fully dismantled** , it was rebranded
* The KKK has never been designated a terrorist organization by the U.S. government, which is shocking
* ICE is a **magnet for radicalized actors** , including January 6 extremists

Right now the problem is leadership, or lack thereof, from **Kristi Noem** to **J. D. Vance**. Classless, shameless, unprofessional cretins. They attack victims like they're a Kristi Noem puppy or Usha Vance family member, instead of pausing for an investigation.
That reaction, David argued, is the tell.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/bee92d92-c4ee-4058-8fbb-7ebca46e5eb2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
_The Usha Vance family, who must appreciate J.D. 's constant demonization of them so they'll suffer more racial harassment--or even attacks--during their lifetimes_
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/bee92d92-c4ee-4058-8fbb-7ebca46e5eb2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
### **4\. Media Failure and the Both-Sides Lie**
A recurring theme: corporate media's abdication of all responsibility to inform their audience of objective truths, be they scientific, historical, or a shooting any person can see violates every rule of law enforcement (and humanity).
Examples called out:
* "Some people say..." reporting when video evidence exists
* treating objective facts as partisan opinion
* laundering propaganda through false balance

Cliff & Walter made clear _this ecosystem allowed fascism to metastasize_ --unchecked, unchallenged, normalized. It's the biggest reason you should [grab a paid subscription to Blue Amp Media--our breaking stories and analysis has already wrecked MAGA narratives, and we can do even more with your help](https://substack.com/redirect/bee92d92-c4ee-4058-8fbb-7ebca46e5eb2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)!
### **5\. The Political Question: Shut Down the Government?**
The most urgent debate of the episode: Should Democrats shut down the government to defund ICE and DHS?
**Cliff 's answer:**
Yes -- _if_ you're willing to fight all the way through.
Key conditions discussed:
* Mandatory body cameras
* No masks, full identification
* Due process enforcement
* Arrests of agents violating state and local laws

The worst option, David & Cliff warned, is pretending to fight then folding, a shot at Democratic leadership (**Chuck Schumer)**. They praise fighters like **Chris Murphy** and argue Dems need new leaders with tactical courage, piercing, memorable messaging, and eagerness to use every procedure in Congress to halt the damage to democracy.
Walter was unequivocal: _Oppose. Oppose. Oppose._
### **6\. A Movement Is Growing -- But Speed Up!**
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/bee92d92-c4ee-4058-8fbb-7ebca46e5eb2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
The show ended with cautious resolve:
* Millions participated in recent anti-authoritarian protests
* Electoral over-performance suggests backlash is building
* Independent media ([Substack](https://substack.com/redirect/bee92d92-c4ee-4058-8fbb-7ebca46e5eb2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), [YouTube](https://substack.com/redirect/57f8df1c-3834-4a18-ad6a-84de5ffa1517?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)) is filling a vacuum left by corporate press

**Walter closed by reminding viewers why he writes: for his kids, and for a future where telling the truth still matters.**
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/bee92d92-c4ee-4058-8fbb-7ebca46e5eb2?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---

name: LeftNet
subject: A writer, a wife, and a mother
body:
Renee Nicole Good.
#
**Yesterday, ICE shot and killed Renee Nicole Good in Minneapolis.**
Renee was 37 years old — a writer, a wife, and a mother whose life was cut short by a reckless and power-crazed ICE agent.
Donald Trump, Kristi Noem, and MAGA Republicans are already trying to claim this was “self-defense,” but video and eyewitness accounts dispute that narrative, showing Renee was attempting to drive away when an agent opened fire.
And it didn’t stop there. **Witnesses report that ICE vehicles blocked ambulance access and refused to allow a physician on scene to provide emergency medical care.** Emergency crews were forced to abandon their ambulance and approach the victim on foot with no stretcher.
The Trump administration has called Renee a “domestic terrorist.” But we all know that’s a lie and a sick and cruel attempt to justify an act of violence that _never_ should have happened in the first place.
We cannot undo what was taken from Renee’s family, but we can show up for her family in the most immediate way possible.
**[So, if you can, please donate today to support Renee’s GoFundMe and help cover funeral expenses and the long road ahead for her wife and young child.](https://act.leftnet.org/go/22149?source=em20260108-1444&t=1&akid=1444%2E2118727%2EBHHZnR)**
**[Donate to support Renee Good’s family](https://act.leftnet.org/go/22149?source=em20260108-1444&t=2&akid=1444%2E2118727%2EBHHZnR)**
In solidarity,
LeftNet

I call it caring about democracy.

| |
---
Friend, The White House says I have “Trump Derangement Syndrome.” I say defending the Constitution isn’t a disorder – it’s the job. Yesterday, I said something on the record that should not be controversial: **When Donald Trump jokes about canceling or disrupting the midterms, we should take him seriously.** History shows that when he says he is going to do something bad, he usually ends up doing something worse. And after ordering surprise military strikes in Venezuela — an operation carried out without a plan, without honesty, and without legal authority — Trump walked onto a stage in Washington and joked about canceling the midterms. That is not funny. And it is not a joke. Instead of responding to the facts or explaining why the President thinks he has the authority to both start wars and “delay” elections, the White House attacked me personally and avoided every substantive question. [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/122935717/593927794/2090747700?amp;refcode=260108_sm_midterms_img&refcode=260108_sm_midterms&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjUvMS83NDc1OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjNGIzMDUzMy1lMmVjLWYwMTEtODE5NS0wMDBkM2ExZDU4YWEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=dUnLjMCmaX2wxODnm5-rDDajJvXOsY483LoO3wi5uo4=) I am simply repeating what the President has said publicly, on multiple occasions:
* He joked about canceling midterms
* He joked about staying in power without elections
* He suggested war could justify blocking elections
* He claimed the “fake news” would call him a dictator

Now, he is installing leaders he personally prefers and deciding when other countries are “allowed” to hold elections again. That should concern every American who believes voters — not presidents — decide when we have elections and who wins them. I served in Iraq during the forever wars, and I have sworn an oath to uphold the Constitution. That oath does not change based on who is in power. It does not expire when the truth becomes inconvenient. And it certainly does not disappear because a White House spokesperson wants to score points on cable news. This campaign exists to tell the truth about threats to our democracy and to challenge leaders in both parties who would rather shrug and hope for the best. **[If you agree that we need leaders who will not wait six more years to confront these threats, I am asking you to join this fight:](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/122935718/593927795/2090747700?refcode=260108_sm_midterms_l1&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjUvMS83NDc1OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjNGIzMDUzMy1lMmVjLWYwMTEtODE5NS0wMDBkM2ExZDU4YWEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=dUnLjMCmaX2wxODnm5-rDDajJvXOsY483LoO3wi5uo4=)** | [CONTRIBUTE](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/122935719/593927796/1375639745?amp;refcode=260108_sm_midterms_b1&refcode=260108_sm_midterms&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMjUvMS83NDc1OCIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJjNGIzMDUzMy1lMmVjLWYwMTEtODE5NS0wMDBkM2ExZDU4YWEiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=dUnLjMCmaX2wxODnm5-rDDajJvXOsY483LoO3wi5uo4=)

subject: Here's what you can do next

body:
| | | Hi Peter, Today in Minneapolis, a 37-year-old woman named Renee Nicole Good was shot and killed by an ICE officer during a federal immigration enforcement operation. Federal officials are claiming self-defense. Local leaders are demanding answers. What we know is that she was a U.S. citizen. **What they want us to feel is fear.** **This is how authoritarian systems work.** Not just through violence, but through the message that follows: Stay quiet. Stay home. Don’t make trouble. And here’s the truth I need you to hold on to. That feeling of overwhelm, that creeping sense of futility? **That’s not your failure. That’s their plan.** Because when people pull back from public life, the powerful get free rein. **When we feel defeated before we begin, we stop building the world we deserve.** That’s how democracy erodes. Not always with a bang, but with a whimper of mass demoralization. **Democracy isn’t just ballots and laws.** It’s whether your family can afford rent. Whether your workplace is safe. Whether you can see a doctor. Whether your kids can learn in peace. Whether your community is treated like it belongs. Fear is the tool they use to make us forget we deserve all of it. So here’s what I’m asking: We need smart, caring people like you to participate in every stage in our democracy. The next step is to participate in and make your voice heard at caucus. **If you are looking for an action to take. This is it. When we feel defeated before we begin, we stop building the world we deserve. That’s how democracy erodes. Not always with a bang, but with a whimper of mass demoralization. body:
[ https://act.squadvictoryfund.com/go/18910?refcode=em20260108-1801-foote&t=1001&akid=1801%2E342411%2EC2k24Q ]Squad Victory Fund

Peter —

Yesterday, in the streets of Minneapolis, my home, ICE agents shot and
killed a woman in her car.

This needless murder is unconscionable and reprehensible.

It’s beyond outrageous that ICE’s reckless, callous actions led to the
death of a US citizen and legal observer. Leaders across Minnesota said
from the start that ICE’s constant escalation would lead to devastating
outcomes like this. They refused to listen.

My heart breaks for the victim’s family, who will have to forever live
with the pain caused by the Trump Administration's reckless and deadly
actions.

This administration has shown, yet again, that it does not care about the
safety of Minnesotans. Instead of protecting our communities, they are
unleashing violence — terrorizing neighborhoods, beating protesters and
observers, and now killing a civilian. For weeks, ICE’s so-called
‘Operation Metro Surge’ has spread fear, chaos, and violence across our
state.

This is not law enforcement. It is state violence. It is simply
indefensible, and ICE must be held accountable. That must include a full,
comprehensive investigation and legal action against the agency.

And when this administration is out of power, that must mean abolishing
ICE and doing away with this cruel, thuggish agency as we pursue a just,
humane, sensible, and orderly immigration system.

Again, my heart breaks for the victim’s family and for my city. Justice
must be found.

In solidarity,

Ilhan Omar

Peter:

ICE is completely out of control. Trump has enabled this rogue agency to
disregard our constitutional rights and terrorize our communities. We
are asking you to join us today in our call to Abolish ICE by signing on
to our petition today. [ https://act.squadvictoryfund.com/signup/abolish-ice-jan-2026/?source=em20260108-1801&t=1002&akid=1801%2E342411%2EC2k24Q ]It’s a simple step to take, but it helps us

clean_body: [ ]Squad Victory Fund Peter — Yesterday, in the streets of Minneapolis, my home, ICE agents shot and killed a woman in her car. This needless murder is unconscionable and reprehensible. It’s beyond outrageous that ICE’s reckless, callous actions led to the death of a US citizen and legal observer. Leaders across Minnesota said from the start that ICE’s constant escalation would lead to devastating outcomes like this. They refused to listen. My heart breaks for the victim’s family, who will have to forever live with the pain caused by the Trump Administration's reckless and deadly actions. This administration has shown, yet again, that it does not care about the safety of Minnesotans. Instead of protecting our communities, they are unleashing violence — terrorizing neighborhoods, beating protesters and observers, and now killing a civilian. For weeks, ICE’s so-called ‘Operation Metro Surge’ has spread fear, chaos, and violence across our state. This is not law enforcement. It is state violence. It is simply indefensible, and ICE must be held accountable. That must include a full, comprehensive investigation and legal action against the agency. And when this administration is out of power, that must mean abolishing ICE and doing away with this cruel, thuggish agency as we pursue a just, humane, sensible, and orderly immigration system. Again, my heart breaks for the victim’s family and for my city. Justice must be found. In solidarity, Ilhan Omar Peter: ICE is completely out of control. Mark Baisley Launches U.S. Senate Bid, Shifts Focus From Statehouse to Washington
| | | | [](https://link.email.joinrmv.)
---
**PRESENTED BY[ROCKYMOUNTAINVOICE.COM](https://link.email.joinrmv.)**
| | Hi friends,
Listen to today's Mountain Minute podcast [here](https://link.email.joinrmv.), or watch on [YouTube](https://link.email.joinrmv.) or [Rumble](https://link.email.joinrmv.). Here is a summary of today's top stories:
🏔️ **Here in Colorado...** Taxpayers were handed a $5.4 million bill after a federal court ruled the state violated the First Amendment by [trying to ban abortion pill reversal at a pro-life clinic](https://link.email.joinrmv.). At the Capitol, lawmakers are bracing for a bruising 2026 election cycle, with a [surge of primary challenges](https://link.email.joinrmv.) signaling voter frustration with appointed incumbents. Public safety remained front and center as federal investigators joined the probe into a [massive Denver apartment fire](https://link.email.joinrmv.) and authorities identified at least 16 victims in a disturbing [sexual abuse case involving a former teacher.](https://link.email.joinrmv.) State Rep. Matt Soper says [Colorado counties must unite](https://link.email.joinrmv.) and demand leverage in Denver to stop unfunded mandates that threaten rural communities and local control.
Meanwhile, [thousands of residents pushed back](https://link.email.joinrmv.) against Xcel Energy over widespread power shutoffs during high winds, calling the response excessive and poorly communicated. On the political front, [State Sen. Mark Baisley launched a U.S. Senate bid](https://link.email.joinrmv.) focused on affordability and federal overreach, while scrutiny intensified over Attorney General Phil Weiser’s [taxpayer-funded lawsuits against President Trump](https://link.email.joinrmv.) and their growing cost to Coloradans.
🇺🇸**On the National Stage...** The Trump administration exposed nearly [$63 billion in foreign government funding to U.S. universities](https://link.email.joinrmv.), highlighting concerns over foreign influence and national security. The move follows an executive order tightening disclosure rules after years of lax enforcement.
This is your Mountain Minute for January 8, 2026.
– Team RMV
---
|
---
**TODAY'S TOP STORIES**
**[Mark Baisley Launches U.S. Senate Bid, Shifts Focus From Statehouse to Washington](https://link.email.joinrmv.)** BY SHAINA COLE, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.joinrmv.)
[](https://link.email.joinrmv.)
Colorado State Senator Mark Baisley has entered the race for U.S. Senate, ending his bid for governor and refocusing his campaign on federal policy decisions he says are driving affordability pressures and limiting Colorado’s ability to chart its own course.
Baisley described the shift as a move from state-level problem solving to addressing issues he believes now originate in Washington.
“I’m moving from being a state senator to a bigger stage in the United States Senate,” he said. He said his earlier campaign sharpened his view of where decisions affecting daily life are increasingly being made — and where he believes Colorado needs stronger representation.
**[READ MORE](https://link.email.joinrmv.)**
|
---
**[If you’re not at the table: Why Matt Soper says counties need leverage now](https://link.email.joinrmv.)** BY JEN SCHUMANN, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.joinrmv.)
* **Unfunded mandates are crushing counties:** State Rep. Matt Soper warns Denver lawmakers are imposing costly regulations on counties without funding, forcing local governments to absorb the fallout while local control is steadily eroded.
* **Why Soper is running for Delta County commissioner:** Term-limited in the House, Soper says the growing pressure on counties is exactly why he’s seeking a commissioner seat—arguing that after years of Coloradans investing in his experience, relationships, and institutional knowledge, it would be wrong to walk away into private industry when counties need strong advocates now more than ever.
* **Counties need leverage, not compliance:** Soper argues that counties are a powerful underused check on power, as is their voice when they come together. He said that the methane landfill mandate was a breaking point that helped galvanize counties statewide.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.joinrmv.)**
|
---

The only way we can continue to spread truth is with your support!
[DONATE TO ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.joinrmv.)
|
---
**[Behind AG Weiser’s taxpayer-funded lawsuits against President Trump: Big claims, bigger costs](https://link.email.joinrmv.)** BY CORY GAINES, [ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE](https://link.email.joinrmv.)
* **Taxpayer-funded lawfare:** Colorado Attorney General Phil Weiser has spent millions of taxpayer dollars pursuing lawsuits against President Trump, branding them as “defending Colorado” while critics argue the cases function more as political resistance than legal necessity.
* **Big claims, costly results:** Despite public victory laps, settlements and outcomes show Colorado has lost or paid out substantial sums in several high-profile cases, raising questions about whether taxpayers are getting results—or just the bill.
* **Rising costs tied to progressive alliances:** The article argues Weiser’s legal strategy reflects broader Democratic deals with activist groups, particularly environmentalists, that may score political points but ultimately drive up costs and make Colorado less affordable for working families.

**[READ MORE](https://link.email.joinrmv.)**
|
---
**ONLY ON ROCKY MOUNTAIN VOICE ⤵️ **
[**All Electric Mandate Or ‘All of The Above’ Energy Policy? You Decide**](https://link.email.joinrmv.)
[****](https://link.email.joinrmv.)**BY RUSS MINARY | COMMENTARY | JANUARY 6** _In December, Excel Energy shut down electricity along the CO Front Range due to “high winds.” It’s difficult to estimate the costs and impacts for individuals, businesses, homeowners, hospitals and grocery stores. Those who had propane, natural gas or diesel-powered generators were able to weather the storm. Everyone else was out of luck._ __
[**State fires back at Peters’ jurisdiction challenge, rejects pardon and supremacy claims**](https://link.email.joinrmv.)
**BY JEN SCHUMANN | STATE | JANUARY 6** _Fifteen months after Tina Peters was taken into custody at sentencing, and as she marks a second New Year behind bars, Colorado’s Attorney General moved to answer her latest court filing, pushing back on a motion that asks the Court of Appeals to decide whether it even has jurisdiction to proceed._
__
[**The Arkansas Valley Conduit debate: What headlines leave out**](https://link.email.joinrmv.)
**BY BOB COOPER | COMMENTARY | JANUARY 6** _In the last week we have seen media all over the state cover Trump’s veto of the Finish the Arkansas Valley Conduit Act. All the headlines point to Trump punishing Colorado and depriving people of having clean water. However, none of the media covered important details about the project. Nor have they asked key questions. Is the project viable and should federal funds be used to support the project?_

**This week, I forced a vote in the House Oversight Committee to subpoena Epstein’s longtime friend, client and financial backer, and his lawyer and accountant; and we won. Even Republican Chair Comer couldn’t shut down our demand for accountability.**
These are the people who helped move the money, shield the powerful, and keep the truth buried for years.
Let me be clear: no one is above accountability. Not billionaires. Not fixers. Not anyone who thought this story would quietly disappear.
**I pushed for these subpoenas because the American people deserve answers — not half-truths, not delays, not another cover-up. Survivors deserve the truth. And Congress has a responsibility to dig until we get it.**
But here’s the reality: accountability only happens when people are willing to fight for it.
The same forces that protected Epstein for decades are still powerful. They are counting on fatigue. They are counting on silence. And they are counting on Democrats backing down.
I won’t.

Team,

Ezra Klein recently singled out Mallory as a candidate to watch. When
thinking about political candidates who are cutting through the noise and
making an impact, he called Mallory “really interesting” and said she’s
earning attention by engaging seriously with the moment. Not just racking
up corporate PAC checks to buy attention, like campaigns have
traditionally done for decades.

state nonstop, meeting people where they are, listening, and building a
campaign centered on real conversations with Michiganders. And
increasingly, national observers agree: she’s in a strong position in one
of the most competitive Senate races in the country.
